items.summary: Relocate gh-api-utils and xfg-template RepoInfo couplings out of src/shared/ to restore shared-as-leaf layering, and fix the repo barrel import angle at the same time

members.summary: src/repo/ is the only top-level module without an index.ts barrel; consumers import from detector.ts as a de-facto barrel
src/shared/ has two files that import types from src/repo/, inverting the shared-as-leaf layering used for runtime imports

action_steps.title: Relocate gh-api-utils and xfg-template out of src/shared/ to restore shared-as-leaf layering
action_steps.detail: src/shared/gh-api-utils.ts imports RepoInfo from src/repo/detector.ts, inverting the shared-as-leaf layering. Move src/shared/gh-api-utils.ts into src/repo/ (or src/vcs/) and update all importers. src/shared/xfg-template.ts also typings RepoInfo — either move the file or invert the dep by narrowing to a RepoDisplayInfo shape passed in. Coordinate with structure-nav-layout which creates the src/repo/ barrel so importers can pivot to '../repo/index.js'.

action_steps.title: Verify madge graph after shared/repo layering fix
action_steps.detail: After the src/shared/gh-api-utils.ts and src/shared/xfg-template.ts relocations land (step 1), run 'npx madge --circular src/' and inspect the graph. Confirm no file under src/shared/ imports from src/repo/detector.ts, src/vcs/, src/cli/, src/sync/, src/settings/, src/lifecycle/, src/output/, or src/config/ (shared must remain a leaf). Confirm downstream importers still resolve via src/repo/detector.ts (or the new barrel from structure-nav). Commit only if graph is clean and no cycles were introduced.
